title: traffic smoothing, two players, NO merger: the client stands near the host so the host streams cars around it; the traffic lever reports the lane and the seq on the host and the ghost count on the client; the client's ghost correction size at packet arrival over a 10 s window is measured twice 30 s apart (reported, and its max must stay under 2.5 m - a chord-cut corner at 12 m/s was up to 3.6 m before this build); no stale drops are expected on a loopback link; ends without leaving; NO save
preconditions: Fixture save1 (the host melaus, Client1). Build TRAFFIC-SMOOTH deployed (dev build: the ghostjitter lever needs BAMP_DEV). The rig runs both instances on ONE machine over the LAN link, so the host's lane is 'reliable' (an over-MTU snapshot rides ReliableUnordered) - the unreliable lane is Steam-only and not rig-observable. The two avatars spawn at their own saved positions; the ghost count on the client is whatever cars the host streams around the client's own position (the host feeds Gley an area per player). FIXTURE HYGIENE: NOTHING is saved.

expect_log.regex: \[TrafficSync\] snapshots on the (unreliable|reliable) lane \(seq-guarded\); identity re-send every 5s\.

steps.note: the host names the lane once per session as soon as it streams
both worlds load and settle; the host streams traffic around each player

steps.expect_result: ^OK traffic role=h ghosts=\d+ hostcars=[1-9]\d* seq=[1-9]\d* dropped=\d+ lane=(unreliable|reliable)
steps.note: the host has live cars and has stamped snapshots

steps.expect_result: ^OK traffic role=c ghosts=(\d+) hostcars=\d+ seq=[1-9]\d* dropped=0 lane=\S+
steps.note: the client receives seq-stamped snapshots; no stale drops on loopback; ghost count REPORTED (depends on where the client stands)
a full 10 s window of samples

window 1: max correction at packet arrival (fold c metric) under 2.5 m (a chord-cut corner at 12 m/s was up to 3.6 m before); a client with NO ghosts nearby answers ERR and fails this step - that is the fixture's geography, not the build (see the note in preconditions) - samples must be > 0 (run 2 measured nothing with the old metric)
window 2, 30 s later: still under 2.5 m - samples must be > 0 (run 2 measured nothing with the old metric)

steps.expect_result: ^OK traffic role=c ghosts=\d+ hostcars=\d+ seq=[1-9]\d* dropped=0 lane=\S+
steps.note: still no stale drops after a minute
